title: Simplify booking form: remove Brand and Request fields; require only Name, Phone Number, and Location

requirements.text: Update the booking (request registration) form to remove the Brand selection UI and the Request field (Request Type selection) so users are no longer asked for those inputs.

quotes: In booking remove brand, Request and only mandate name, number, location

acceptanceCriteria: The booking form no longer displays the Brand dropdown and the conditional 'Specify Brand' input.
The booking form no longer displays the 'Request Type' radio group (service/spares).

requirements.text: Change booking form validation so that only Name, Phone Number, and Location are required; all other existing fields on the page must be optional (no required validation errors).
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form with only Name, Phone Number, and Location filled succeeds (assuming the user is authenticated).
Category, Address, and Description (if still shown) do not block submission when left empty and do not show 'required' validation errors.
Name and Location are validated as non-empty strings.
Phone Number is validated as non-empty and continues to use the existing phone-number format validation.

requirements.text: Ensure request creation still works after removing Brand and Request inputs by providing sensible defaults for the removed fields when calling the existing createRequest mutation (e.g., Brand as "other" with empty text, Request Type default, and empty strings for any optional text fields not provided).
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend still calls the existing createRequest flow successfully without requiring user input for Brand or Request Type.
A request created via the simplified form can be opened on the success and detail pages without client errors.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI component sources).
Do not modify frontend immutable hook files (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
nonGoals: Changing the backend Motoko createRequest signature or request schema (this update should be achievable via frontend defaults and validation changes).
Redesigning admin dashboards, filtering, or track-status behavior beyond what is required to keep the simplified booking submission working.
